heading: Features explained in detail
subtext: Expand each section to learn more. Built with native <details>/<summary> — zero JavaScript.

items.title: How does config-driven rendering work?
items.description: Each page has a JSON config that defines sections, variants, copy, and media. The ConfigPageRenderer reads this JSON and renders the matching components. No templates to edit for content changes.

items.title: Can I add custom themes?
items.description: Yes. Create a new JSON file in src/configs/themes/ with the standard token schema (bg, text, accent, surface, border, fonts, etc.). Import it in the theme index and it's instantly available as a themeVariant option.

items.title: Is there a JavaScript runtime?
items.description: No. All components are pure Astro — they render to static HTML at build time. Zero client-side JavaScript unless you explicitly add an island (React, Vue, Svelte) for interactive features.

items.title: How do I add a new page?
items.description: Run node scripts/new-page.mjs <page-name>. This creates an Astro page and a JSON config. Or use the new-site.mjs script which scaffolds a full config + user-content page.
